review:
Twilight Princess is a 5x5 cluster slot where five or more adjacent symbols form a win. Bells, flowers and the princess are the symbols, and wilds with multipliers up to 10x can land to help complete clusters.

Three or more scatters award 10 free spins, and any wild that lands during the bonus becomes sticky for the rest of the round. On top of that, the princess can randomly add extra sticky wild multipliers at any point, increasing the chance of forming large multiplied clusters. The advertised maximum is 7,500x and the RTP is 96.08%. It's a lighter alternative to the studio's bigger cluster games, with a clear sticky-wild bonus.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
